text:
sarah: Heads-up — nightly canary on the h100 pool is red. Warmup failing across a few shards: OOM on some, 'invalid device function' on others. attaching quick triage.
ci-bot: job: nightly/h100-canary #4521 failed on shard 3/6 — exit 137, kernel message: Xid 79, observed PCIe reset during warmup.
yuki: Is this new after today's driver bump to 531.41? I saw that land in canary this morning.
devon: That's my rollout. Can you paste the failing shard log? I'll start checking driver symbols/PTX JIT offsets.
sarah: Pasted excerpt from shard 3: 
```
[  123.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1f): 79, PID=12345, GPU=00000000:3d:00.0
libcuda: invalid device function
OOM killer killed process 9876 (python)
```
pranav: Tried a quick local repro on an A5000 VM and it didn't fail — looks H100-specific so far.
yuki: Rack 7 had a couple PCI link retrains earlier today; could be noise + a sensitive driver change.
devon: OK. Plan: pin a stable older driver and rerun targeted shard. If it reproduces, we'll bisect between driver versions. Requesting rerun with driver=530.86 and WARMUP_THREADS=1 to reduce concurrency variance.
sarah: OK requeueing now. ci-runner: please run shard=3 with driver=530.86 and env WARMUP_THREADS=1.
ci-runner: rerun submitted (job id: rerun-4521-3-53086). ETA ~20m.
sarah: @devon @yuki ping me if you'd like the logs streamed or I should leave the job running longer for traces.
devon: thanks. If rerun fails, trigger a micro-bisect: spin canary with drivers [529.37, 530.86, 531.41] sampling 5 warmups each to get signal.
yuki: I'll monitor PCI/NVLink counters on the rack and gather pcie stats during the rerun.
infra-bot: scheduled diagnostic collection for rerun-4521-3: collect-syslog, nvidia-smi -q, dmesg, nvlink-stats -> https://internal.ci/diag/rerun-4521-3
sarah: sweet. reporting back when rerun finishes.
pranav: tagging the PR that touched the allocator with "h100-canary:needs-bisect" so we don't lose context.
sarah: thx :thumbsup:
